title: Popover
summary: The popover object provides a native HTML way to show overlays with plain elements and attributes.

description.main: Use the popover object to show native HTML overlays with a trigger button and a popover element. The examples below use normal elements together with supported attributes such as `popovertarget`, `popovertargetaction`, `popover`, `data-popover-backdrop`, and the styleguide placement attributes.

attributes.popovertarget: Connects a trigger button to a popover by id.
attributes.popovertargetaction: Controls whether the trigger toggles, shows, or hides the popover.
attributes.popover: Marks the element as a popover.
attributes.data-js-popover-relative-to-trigger: Optional. Set to `true` to position the popover relative to its trigger instead of the viewport.
attributes.data-js-popover-horizontal-placement: Optional. Sets horizontal placement to `left`, `center`, or `right`.
attributes.data-js-popover-vertical-placement: Optional. Sets vertical placement to `top`, `center`, or `bottom`.
attributes.data-popover-backdrop: Optional. Adds a backdrop behind the popover.

available.popovertarget: Any element with a matching id can be used as a popover target
